mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals increased consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over 2 months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over 1 month, coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% over the same period, signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 2% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over 6 months signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over 1 month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over 2 quarters signals a recessionary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as corporate earnings decline and consumer demand weakens.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% within 2 quarters.
